name: a record entry carrying a direction override
why: A direction override reverses the order the characters after it are displayed in, so a fact can read on the page as one claim and be stored in the snapshot as another -- and the character is invisible in `git diff`, which is the review this snapshot's whole safety argument rests on. Refused outright, as are the direction isolates (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026).

rows.headline: the date-order test had a blind spot
